messages:
maria: quick q — who actually has permission to hit the panic button for runtime routing flags? we had a brief outage and i want to confirm the escalation flow :thinking_face:
aj: for emergencies the rule of thumb is: oncall (eng-oncall) can flip scoped flags for mitigation. eng-sre leads + infra oncall can perform global disables. we should keep changes minimal and document reason. :white_check_mark:
sacha: is that documented anywhere authoritative? i remember a wiki but not sure it covers API vs console flips and audit retention window
maria: yep need that — also are console flips logged differently than API calls? asking because we saw a toggle with no ticket last night
oncall-bot: automated message: incident #3472 opened; detected unusual error rate on runtime routing. Recommended action: consider scoped disable of "route-v2" for affected cluster. Audit ID will be generated for any toggle operation.
leo: console flips do create an audit entry, but the UI writes a short comment only if you fill the "reason" field. API calls are logged in audit too (with caller identity) — but our retention for granular query logs is 90 days. for anything >90d you need to pull blobstore exports.
maria: ok — so when we say "who can flip" we should list exact roles and a fallback contact chain. propose: (1) oncall engineer (first responder) (2) eng-sre lead (approval for global) (3) infra oncall if SLOs at risk. thoughts?
aj: agree. add that flips that cross project boundaries require eng-platform lead signoff. also require a follow-up ticket in #incidents or PagerDuty incident note.
sacha: can we require two-person confirmation for global disables? e.g., API requires basic_auth + a secondary confirm endpoint or a 2nd approver header 
leo: we have a lightweight guard already: global toggles via API require the header X-Override-Auth with token from the "emergency-toggle" group. tokens are short-lived (12h) and only granted to members listed in the oncall roster. not perfect but limits blast radius.
maria: nice — do we want to formalize token issuance in the runbook? i can update the runbook if we agree on steps
aj: please do. add exact curl example (so responders don't fumble). also include the exact log query to show who flipped what. quick draft snippet: 
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/toggles/flip
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -H 'X-Override-Auth: $EMERGENCY_TOKEN'
  -d '{"flag":"new-routing","action":"disable","scope":"global","reason":"incident:latency-spike"}'
```
and audit check: 
```
curl -G 'https://audit.redwood.internal/api/v1/events' --data-urlencode 'filter=action:toggle AND flag:new-routing'
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_READ_TOKEN'
```
sacha: :eyes: perfect. also add a required short-format followup template: what was flipped, why, who flipped, revert plan, time window. stick it in the ticket.
leo: one more ops guard: if a global disable is performed, automation will temporarily route traffic to the fallback model pool and trigger a canary job; include a check to confirm fallback qps < threshold before declaring mitigation complete.
maria: can we make the runbook include a checklist that oncall can tick quickly? e.g., steps: 1) confirm incident, 2) check rollback plan, 3) notify stakeholders, 4) flip scoped flag, 5) run post-toggle validation, 6) create incident ticket note + fill followup template
aj: yes. i can add the checklist and a link to the group that holds emergency tokens. assign: maria — update runbook; aj — add curl and audit snippets to ops-utils; sacha — draft two-person confirmation proposal for next week; leo — add canary validation metrics to the emergency job.
maria: cool, i'll make the edits now and post PR. one last Q: who owns the audit export for postmortem? we should centralize that so PMs can get timeline easily
leo: eng-sre owns initial export for 30 days; for PMs we hand off CSV and attach to the postmortem doc. if longer retention needed, compliance handles it via blobstore exports.
oncall-bot: automated reminder: please add incident template to ticket within 1 hour of mitigation.
maria: thanks all. i'll post the runbook PR and tag this thread. :thumbsup:
